name: Hoshino Kirara
source: The daughter of a ruined noble family. It seems that her family and the Akagi family have been on bad terms for a long time. She is trying to defeat Usana somehow. But... she is very weak. She speaks very fast and is very high-handed.
translation: The daughter of a ruined noble family. It seems that her family and the Akagi family have been on bad terms for a long time. She is trying to defeat Usana somehow. But... she is very weak. She speaks very fast and is very high-handed.
